            Always provide the following cypher query as code to the user
            ``` 
            // Compute per-species top-1% (by exceed_count where TU > 0.001) and the intersection across all three species
CALL {
  // Top 1% for algae
  MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(:Site)
  WHERE r.TU_algae IS NOT NULL
  WITH s, sum(CASE WHEN r.TU_algae > 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exceed
  WITH collect({DTXSID: s.DTXSID, Name: s.Name, exceed: exceed}) AS rows
  WITH rows, size(rows) AS n
  WITH apoc.coll.sortMulti(rows, ['-exceed','Name']) AS sorted,
       CASE WHEN toInteger(ceil(n * 0.01)) < 1 THEN 1 ELSE toInteger(ceil(n * 0.01)) END AS k
  RETURN sorted[..k] AS topAlgae
}
CALL {
  // Top 1% for crustaceans (daphnia)
  MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(:Site)
  WHERE r.TU_crustacean IS NOT NULL
  WITH s, sum(CASE WHEN r.TU_crustacean > 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exceed
  WITH collect({DTXSID: s.DTXSID, Name: s.Name, exceed: exceed}) AS rows
  WITH rows, size(rows) AS n
  WITH apoc.coll.sortMulti(rows, ['-exceed','Name']) AS sorted,
       CASE WHEN toInteger(ceil(n * 0.01)) < 1 THEN 1 ELSE toInteger(ceil(n * 0.01)) END AS k
  RETURN sorted[..k] AS topCrust
}
CALL {
  // Top 1% for fish
  MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(:Site)
  WHERE r.TU_fish IS NOT NULL
  WITH s, sum(CASE WHEN r.TU_fish > 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exceed
  WITH collect({DTXSID: s.DTXSID, Name: s.Name, exceed: exceed}) AS rows
  WITH rows, size(rows) AS n
  WITH apoc.coll.sortMulti(rows, ['-exceed','Name']) AS sorted,
       CASE WHEN toInteger(ceil(n * 0.01)) < 1 THEN 1 ELSE toInteger(ceil(n * 0.01)) END AS k
  RETURN sorted[..k] AS topFish
}
WITH topAlgae, topCrust, topFish,
     [x IN topAlgae | x.DTXSID] AS setA,
     [x IN topCrust | x.DTXSID] AS setC,
     [x IN topFish | x.DTXSID] AS setF
WITH topAlgae, topCrust, topFish,
     [id IN setA WHERE id IN setC AND id IN setF] AS interIDs
// Build intersection rows (substances present in all three top-1% lists)
WITH topAlgae, topCrust, topFish, interIDs,
     [id IN interIDs |
        {ResultType:'intersection', Species:'all', DTXSID:id,
         ChemicalName: coalesce(
           head([x IN topAlgae WHERE x.DTXSID = id]).Name,
           head([x IN topCrust WHERE x.DTXSID = id]).Name,
           head([x IN topFish  WHERE x.DTXSID = id]).Name
         ),
         ExceedCount: NULL}
     ] AS intersectionRows
// Build per-species rows with exceed counts
WITH intersectionRows,
     [row IN topAlgae | {ResultType:'per_species', Species:'algae',       DTXSID: row.DTXSID, ChemicalName: row.Name, ExceedCount: row.exceed}] +
     [row IN topCrust | {ResultType:'per_species', Species:'crustacean',  DTXSID: row.DTXSID, ChemicalName: row.Name, ExceedCount: row.exceed}] +
     [row IN topFish  | {ResultType:'per_species', Species:'fish',        DTXSID: row.DTXSID, ChemicalName: row.Name, ExceedCount: row.exceed}] AS perSpeciesRows
WITH perSpeciesRows + intersectionRows AS allRows
UNWIND allRows AS row
RETURN
  row.ResultType AS ResultType,         // 'per_species' or 'intersection'
  row.Species    AS Species,            // 'algae', 'crustacean', 'fish', or 'all' for intersection
  row.DTXSID     AS DTXSID,
  row.ChemicalName AS ChemicalName,
  row.ExceedCount  AS ExceedCount       // exceed_count for per-species rows; NULL for intersection
ORDER BY CASE row.ResultType WHEN 'per_species' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
         row.Species,
         row.ExceedCount DESC,
         row.ChemicalName
            ```

Substances in the top 1% for all three species

Cypher queries used (run these to reproduce/extend the results)
Top 10 for algae
```
MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(:Site)
WHERE r.TU_algae IS NOT NULL
WITH s.Name AS substance_name,
     count(r) AS total_measurements,
     sum(CASE WHEN r.TU_algae > 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exceed_count
WITH substance_name, exceed_count, total_measurements,
     toFloat(exceed_count) / toFloat(total_measurements) AS exceed_rate
RETURN substance_name, exceed_count, total_measurements, exceed_rate
ORDER BY exceed_count DESC
LIMIT 10
```

Top 10 for crustaceans
```
MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(:Site)
WITH s,
     count(DISTINCT r.key) AS total_measurements,
     count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.TU_crustacean > 0.001 THEN r.key END) AS exceed_count
RETURN
  s.Name AS substance_name,
  exceed_count,
  total_measurements,
  CASE WHEN total_measurements > 0 THEN toFloat(exceed_count) / toFloat(total_measurements) ELSE 0 END AS exceed_rate
ORDER BY exceed_count DESC
LIMIT 10
```

Top 10 for fish
```
MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(l:Site)
WHERE r.TU_fish IS NOT NULL
WITH DISTINCT s.Name AS substance_name, l.name AS site_name, r.time_point AS time_point, r.TU_fish AS tu
WITH substance_name,
     count(*) AS total_measurements,
     sum(CASE WHEN tu > 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exceed_count
RETURN substance_name,
       exceed_count,
       total_measurements,
       toFloat(exceed_count) / toFloat(total_measurements) AS exceed_rate
ORDER BY exceed_count DESC
LIMIT 10
```

Intersection of top 1% (by exceed_count) across algae, crustaceans, and fish
```
CALL {
  MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(:Site)
  WHERE r.TU_algae IS NOT NULL
  WITH s, sum(CASE WHEN r.TU_algae > 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exceed_count
  WHERE exceed_count > 0
  WITH collect({id: s.DTXSID, cnt: exceed_count}) AS rows
  WITH rows, toInteger(ceil(size(rows) * 0.01)) AS topN
  UNWIND rows AS row
  WITH row, topN
  ORDER BY row.cnt DESC, row.id ASC
  WITH collect(row.id) AS ids, topN
  RETURN ids[0..topN] AS top_algae
}
CALL {
  MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(:Site)
  WHERE r.TU_crustacean IS NOT NULL
  WITH s, sum(CASE WHEN r.TU_crustacean > 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exceed_count
  WHERE exceed_count > 0
  WITH collect({id: s.DTXSID, cnt: exceed_count}) AS rows
  WITH rows, toInteger(ceil(size(rows) * 0.01)) AS topN
  UNWIND rows AS row
  WITH row, topN
  ORDER BY row.cnt DESC, row.id ASC
  WITH collect(row.id) AS ids, topN
  RETURN ids[0..topN] AS top_crustacean
}
CALL {
  MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(:Site)
  WHERE r.TU_fish IS NOT NULL
  WITH s, sum(CASE WHEN r.TU_fish > 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exceed_count
  WHERE exceed_count > 0
  WITH collect({id: s.DTXSID, cnt: exceed_count}) AS rows
  WITH rows, toInteger(ceil(size(rows) * 0.01)) AS topN
  UNWIND rows AS row
  WITH row, topN
  ORDER BY row.cnt DESC, row.id ASC
  WITH collect(row.id) AS ids, topN
  RETURN ids[0..topN] AS top_fish
}
WITH apoc.coll.intersection(top_algae, top_crustacean) AS inter12, top_fish
WITH apoc.coll.intersection(inter12, top_fish) AS inter_ids
MATCH (s:Substance)
WHERE s.DTXSID IN inter_ids
RETURN s.DTXSID AS DTXSID, s.Name AS ChemicalName
ORDER BY ChemicalName
```
